da-non-sequitur.notes: Passes criterion based on structural review.

da-non-sequitur.evidence: (S↔P column of prop:confinement-phase-stratification row) Both the sibling and the library declare `QOU.BraidKnot.ConfinementPhaseStratification`, and both are self-assuming: the sibling class has fields `isOpen` and `mu_constant`, and the library `HasSDPRegularity` has fields `feasible_isOpen` and `mu_locally_constant`, each equal to the conclusion. Its docstring says "derived, not assumed". The sibling docstring says "honest sorry" but there is no sorry. Claims 2, 4 and 5 and σ_F analyticity are unencoded. Proof: (2) the complement of an open set is not in general a finite zero set of minors (an infeasible interval has codim 0); (3) uses two different "phase boundaries" (loss of Slater strictness vs a dual u_λ* crossing 0); it proves continuity of σ_F, while the statement claims real-analyticity

Full review 2026-11-21. The diff is a relocation (commit 214e6faed31 moved the cluster into nuclear-interactions) plus re-wrapping in *Proof.*; the arguments are unchanged. Earlier defects stand. Claim (2): the complement of an open feasible set is not in general a finite zero set of principal minors, since an infeasible interval has codimension 0. Claim (3) uses two different notions of phase boundary (loss of Slater strictness vs a dual u_lambda* crossing zero). It proves continuity of sigma_F, but the statement claims real-analyticity. The Lean classes are self-assuming (fields equal to the conclusion).
